incidents.summary: A proposed class-action lawsuit alleged that SSP America CID violated wage-and-hour laws by failing to pay airport restaurant employees the required minimum wage.

sources.title: Class-action lawsuit seeks to collect wages for airport restaurant workers • Iowa Capital Dispatch
sources.quote: A Linn County woman representing workers at airport eateries throughout Iowa has filed a potential class action lawsuit against her employer alleging violations of state and federal wage-and-hour laws.

sources.title: Class-action lawsuit seeks to collect wages for airport restaurant workers • Iowa Capital Dispatch
sources.quote: The lawsuit accuses SSP America CID of violating the Fair Labor Standards Act’s requirements and a resulting failure to pay employees the federally mandated minimum wage for all hours worked.
